scope.meaning: StorageService-only coverage using storage-only tests; not a full frontend application coverage report.

baseline.note: Combined full frontend report exercises extra storage behavior and was separately reported by root as60.71/59.65/58.77/53.02. These percentages are not interchangeable.

reproduction.defect: Bulk feature hydration lacked account-generation, clear-epoch and per-key-mutation guards, so a delayed IDB response restored old-user/cleared/removed rows and overwrote newer values.
reproduction.approvedFix: Root reviewed the three failing regressions and explicitly approved minimal production changes to hydrateAllFeatureData.

final.assertion: Each StorageService line/statement/function/branch percentage is at least98.

runnerConfig.purpose: Temporary targeted runner config routes report artifacts away from shared frontend output. No shared/root configuration was changed.

productionBehavior: Capture session generation, cache epoch and local mutation revisions before opening the database.
Reject obsolete reads after opening and when getAll responds.
Merge only missing keys whose local revisions are unchanged, preserving current values and deletions.
Return the count of actually merged keys; successful explicit backup hydration remains supported.
behavioralEvidence: Metadata/feature separation persists actual rows at an independent controlled IDB request/transaction boundary; bootstrap reopens metadata and lazy hydration restores only requested payloads.
Version4 legal acceptance migration, legacy feature-store separation, fresh DB stores/index creation and no redundant version4 legal migration.
Bootstrap reuse, no-IDB memory fallback, database-open retry, request/transaction failures and graceful development migration failures.
Development identity migration preserves preexisting preferences, deduplicates history by timestamp/range and keeps base/other owners untouched.
Stats history owner/range reads, timestamp ordering, save errors/retry, explicit-ID deletion deduplication, per-owner clear and all-history clear.
Per-owner/key cloud write sequencing with independent-key concurrency, retry after rejection, and logout dropping queued local/cloud writes.
Durable metadata commit cleans stale feature-store copy; active preference and Stats transactions abort on session invalidation and drain cleanly.
HydrateItems uses batches of at most4, stops before next batch after session replacement, preserves strict/tolerant failure semantics and prevents removed/cleared/newer-key resurrection.
Bulk hydration discards stale session/clear reads, preserves newer/removed/preexisting keys, retries freshly, and skips reads if session/epoch changes while the database opens.

nativeBrowserComplement.status: Existing native IndexedDB persistence/quota/strict-read/profile-ownership tests maintained by root. This agent did not rerun browser tests and does not claim controlled Vitest IDB fixtures are native IndexedDB.

remaining.interpretation: Four uncovered branches are defensive getAll-result fallbacks; native IndexedDB getAll supplies an array even when empty. Uncovered queue predecessor rejection handler is guarded by its predecessor queue catch. All remain in denominator; no exclusions/ignores introduced.

limitations: Full frontend/worker/edge application gates, full CI, browser workflows and design verification are root-owned and cannot be inferred from this file-targeted report.
IDB fixtures exercise real StorageService with isolated controlled platform boundaries; native-browser transport is complementary evidence, not merged into branch coverage.
No hosted endpoint, real credential/data, notification, shared release, deployment, branch operation, commit or shared configuration was used.
